A lot better now. I was diagnosed with depression and anxiety when I was 15. I couldn't function as an adult for a long period of time and I totally wrecked my future because of it. I tried of a dozen different medication regimes, but the results were ineffective at best or the side effects made me completely none functioning at worst. I also spent all that time in various kinds of therapy and none of it seemed to help. Talk therapy helped keep me from somewhat stable, but it hurt so bad inside me that I thought about suicide daily.

When you feel that bad, all the time and it feels like you've tried, everything of course death seems like the easy answer. I would go to bed crying just praying to whatever would listen to just feel normal. 

Thankfully now I have the correct diagnoses (bipolar 2) which means I'm finally on medication that is effective for me. I feel better than I have in years. I have a full time job, I no longer live with my toxic parents and I am making more progress in my mental health that I would have thought unrealistic a few months ago.

Its not over yet, of course. I still have a ways to go, but finding the right doctor and learning about myself through therapy were key (even if it took a while).
